title: Ghoul Physiology
summary: What vitae does to a ghoul's body, by one Kindred researcher's account.

claims.text: A ghoul's body replaces the vitae in its system with ordinary blood in about a month, close to one lunar cycle.
Flesh cut from a living ghoul rots a little more slowly than human flesh, a difference visible only with close study on small pieces.
The researcher links the month-long cycle to the moon, an idea offered as speculation.

title: Kindred Factions Seen by Ghouls
summary: How ghouls who swap notes describe the sects.

claims.text: Ghouls describe the anarchs as Kindred who want to tear down the secret government without saying what should replace it.
Some anarchs are said to treat ghouls fairly well, but ghouls warn each other to read the fine print.

title: The Bratovitch
summary: A depraved revenant family that breeds ghoul hounds for the Sabbat.

claims.text: The Bratovitch breed ghoul hounds for the Sabbat and earn grudging respect for stalking and fighting.
No other revenant family or clan enjoys their company.
They push for self-improvement through heavy Vicissitude changes and by eating fallen foes, and some have tried rituals to draw power from Lupines.
